featured_reviews.name: Pranay Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I honestly don’t understand the hype around Biryani By Kilo’s Hyderabadi biryani. Ordered it expecting that rich, aromatic, authentic experience—but what I got was just disappointing.

First off, the rice and meat felt completely disconnected. A good Hyderabadi biryani should have that deep infusion of flavors where every bite hits—but here it tasted like the masala never really seeped in. The chicken was just okay, nothing juicy or tender enough to stand out.

And the spice balance? Either bland in parts or randomly overpowering in others. It lacked that signature warmth and complexity you expect. The aroma was there when I opened the pot, but the taste just didn’t live up to it.

For the price they charge, this felt more like a watered-down version of what Hyderabadi biryani is supposed to be. Definitely not worth the premium tag.

Really expected better—this one missed the mark.

featured_reviews.name: Shoeb Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
On the recent visit to Mumbai at sister house plan to have the Biryani at home since meet after the long after she planned to serves Biryani. I suggest her to order from this place for which she doubted about quality and taste, I said try this once you will love this for which she agreed. Quickly check the app and glad it serves to location and place the order to them.

Now coming to what we have,
Paneer Nawabi: This is the one of the dish which I was certainly looking to tasting for. This goes well, succulent and soft piece of paneer easy pricked with finger which absorb all the flavours from the gravy. The gravy was onion-tomato based, slightly thick with ginger julienne aromatic with kewra water and was mellow in flavour slightly sweet from the onions and best goes with Ulte Tawa ka Paratha. The plus point is the taste and quantity of the gravy which can be sharable between 4-5peoples. Highly recommended for this.

Thin, soft and easily break within the fingers and absorb all the gravy when it was dunk on it. The size is bigger comparing to those days which is too good. Recommended to have this here.

The long grain basmati rice cooked to perfection in succulent pieces of chicken coated well in marination taste medium spicy but with mild aromatic flavour of spices, ghee and slight sweetness from the fried onions. The biryani certainly had absorbed the flavours of ghee even it turn aromatic to Chicken. This is the sort of Biryani which is completed in itself and enjoyable but to accompaniment it serves with Mirchi ka Saalan which slightly disappointed because of raw smell of peanuts and big size of red chillies taste need to improvise here. Highly recommended if you love your Biryani mellow and mild spicy.

Skipped the dessert this time.

Packaging was done too good and no spillage at all, delivery was done on time prior to given time.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Curry’s & Cocktails is a refreshing new addition to Ghatkopar’s dining scene, thoughtfully spread across three distinct sections. The ground level offers casual dining, perfect for family meals or catching up with friends. The next level is designed for intimate private parties, ideal for small groups, while the top floor transforms into a lounge bar with a live DJ, setting the mood for a lively evening.

We started with drinks, and the Achari Whiskey cocktail truly stood out — unique, bold, and packed with flavour.
For a non-alcoholic option, the Rising Sun mocktail, a refreshing blend of watermelon and pineapple juice, was light and delightful.

The appetizers didn’t disappoint. The Dahi ke Kebab was soft, creamy, and beautifully balanced, while the Chicken Tikka Balochi was medium spicy, well-chargrilled, and full of smoky goodness. A special mention goes to the Mumbai Patty Bao — a fun, creative take on street food, featuring a traditional Mumbai-style deep-fried potato patty tucked into a soft bao bun with onions, garlic chutney, lettuce, mint mayo, and fried salted green chillies.

For mains, we tried the Pink Lady Mee (Chicken). It was flavourful, vibrant, and nicely balanced.

Dessert was a pleasant surprise with the Shrikhand Crème Brûlée, blending classic Indian flavours with a modern twist — a perfect end to the meal.

Overall, Curry’s & Cocktails offers a lovely dining experience with good food, creative drinks, and versatile spaces to suit every mood — from relaxed family dinners to high-energy nights with music. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in or around Ghatkopar.

.
DAHl IDLI

DIL KHUSH. I already had this named dosa before but here the taste hits next level which makes you remember it.
PIZZA UTHAPPAM
It's fusion of base uthappam & pizza spreads on it. You get dosa & pizza taste together in balanced flavors. Good to try once.
PINEAPPLE SHEERA
Never miss this Indian delicacy at any cost or else you would regret that you hadn't taste. Sheera was very succulent & satisfying in taste. This ending would make you feel coming worthy here.
.
You can easily see their kitchen from seating area Or outside standing area which is neat & clean.
They maintain complete hygiene while preparation of food which I really appreciate as I myself went to kitchen to take some making clips. It has limited seating tables & standing tables outside which is keep getting packed up in short intervals. You must visit this place & enjoy the authentic south Indian food. featured_reviews.name: aakruti dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Tripo Spice, a rooftop place with great ambience, ample seating space, and beautifully designed décor. The overall vibe is lovely and makes for a very pleasant dining experience.
We loved the food — the white sauce pasta was creamy and delicious, the dry Manchurian was flavourful, and the mint paneer was equally delicious. We also tried their special Belgium Brownie milkshake, which was super chocolaty and absolutely indulgent.
The staff is very courteous and polite, adding to the overall warm and pleasant experience.
The only downside was the seating policy — despite calling in advance, we were informed that weekend bookings are not accepted and only walk-ins are allowed. Additionally, they made us wait until all our friends had arrived before seating us, which felt a bit unnecessary.
Overall, it’s a wonderful family restaurant with good food, great ambience, and a well-designed rooftop setting. Definitely worth visiting for the food and ambience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:

Visited this place expecting decent food, but the experience left a lot to be desired. The dahi wada, in particular, was quite disappointing. Instead of having a balanced flavor, it leaned heavily toward sweetness, making it feel more like a dessert than a savory dish. On top of that, the wada itself was unusually small and did not seem properly prepared, both in texture and taste.

What stands out most is that the food feels underwhelming for the amount being charged. A restaurant can charge premium prices, but there should be some effort reflected in taste, portion, and preparation. Sadly, that balance felt missing here.

The ambience works if you just want to sit over tea and spend time, but for food that actually satisfies, there are far better options around.

featured_reviews.name: Abbasali Sorangwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
After trying idli sambar, dahi wada, veg pulao, veg cheese sandwich, and Chinese fried rice over multiple visits, I feel this place is better suited for chai and conversations rather than actual dining.

What disappointed me most was the consistency in poor food quality. I gave the idli sambar two chances on two consecutive weeks, hoping the first experience was just a bad day, but unfortunately, it was the same both times. At ₹70, the idli itself felt poorly prepared, and the sambar had a strange sharp taste, almost acidic, as if too much soda had been added. Instead of feeling satisfying, it actually left me with indigestion after both visits.

Pricing would still be acceptable if the quality matched, but that simply was not the case here. Expensive food is understandable, disappointing food at premium prices is not.

Good spot for chai and hanging out, but if you care about food quality and value, I would avoid coming here for dinner.

featured_reviews.name: Sankalp P
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Delightful Experience at NEO WELCOME!

We had an amazing time dining at NEO WELCOME. We tried the Mysore Masala Cheese Dosa, and it was simply wow — crispy, flavorful, and cheesy in the best way possible. The Schezwan Fried Rice was tasty and generous in portion, perfect for sharing.

We also tried their Cold Coffee, which was slightly on the sweeter side but still refreshing and enjoyable. The Paneer Paratha and Sada Butter Cheese Dosa were equally satisfying and lived up to the expectations.

What really stood out, apart from the great food, was the excellent service. The staff were very attentive — one of the waiters was constantly going around refilling cold water glasses the moment they were empty. Such thoughtful service is rare and truly appreciated.

Located just outside the station, it’s super convenient to get to. Overall, a fantastic veg restaurant with great food, top-notch service, and a welcoming vibe. Highly recommended and a must-visit!

Alu  sukka  bhaji  and batata wadas(both Aloo preps) there was one piece fried aluwadi and aluwadi  rassa bhaji with another piece of aluwadi soaked in the rassa. No other veggie... The steamed modak was chewy, with thick outer covering made using dry coconut... Not authentic ,no fresh coconut and not at all melt in the mouth sort of .. The dal was bland and rice half cooked and masale bhaat was not flavourfull  at all.. All the items served were as if they were given for tasting.. Amras  took at least 20 mins to reach our table.. Even kokum sarbat ordered at the beginning took 20 mins++ to reach our table. Thali  is too hyped.. Not at all worth the price.. Rs.625 plus. Service too slow.. We were told they have to give time for online orders. Vaangyache  kaap  and aluwadi  were good. Overall too hyped, not authentic ,bland food.. Just going through some vlogs we ended up at the wrong place.. There are many more restaurants serving very very authentic maharashtrian food in Vile Parle, Dadar and Thane.Traditional Maharashtrian food is rich and flavourful..this is no where near to authentic maharashtrian food.

featured_reviews.name: Prasad K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vikhroli Social – Elevated Experience with a Spacious Rooftop

I recently visited Vikhroli Social with my office colleagues, and it turned out to be a better experience than my previous visits. The key improvement was their expanded rooftop space. Earlier, the rooftop was more like a small balcony, but now it’s a huge, open, and spacious area. If you prefer a quieter atmosphere without loud music, the rooftop is definitely the best spot. It offers ample space and a relaxed vibe, although the bench table seating felt a bit too compact and could have been more comfortable.

We were a group of four and ordered a variety of dishes. The Veg Platter was average — nothing exceptional, but decent. The Munchao Soup, on the other hand, was quite good with a rich and flavorful broth. We also tried Fish and Chips, which were good but could have been seasoned better. The fish options were quite limited, which was a bit disappointing. However, the corn starter was a pleasant surprise — crispy, well-seasoned, and delicious.

The highlight of the evening was the Wings Platter, which came with four different types of wings. Each preparation had a distinct flavor profile — some spicy, some sweet with BBQ sauce — and every single one tasted amazing. The variety and quality of the wings truly stood out.

Overall, it was a great experience, especially because of the improved rooftop setup. The spacious and relaxed atmosphere, combined with good food and service, made it a memorable evening. If you’re visiting Vikhroli Social, the rooftop is definitely the place to be!

featured_reviews.review_text: It was my first time as an NRI at New Vijaywada Restaurant. I arrived late at 11:00 PM, but the staff still served our food promptly and with great service.
